profile.headline: SWE @ Sony Interactive Entertainment - Playstation
profile.summary:
Hi! My name is Faith, and I am a Filipina software developer, connector and leader. I aim to develop meaningful experiences that connect people, whether it be through technology or empowering teams towards a common goal.

I am currently a compilers engineer at Playstation, and I also have background in computer graphics (rendering) and HCI through my Master's degree at UCSD. 

Let's make a better world, together!

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
Eighth College: Sept 2025-
Sixth College: Aug 2023-Jun 2025

Actively participate as an advisor and role model in the development of a comprehensive residential life program.
Orchestrate student move-ins and residence life transitions for 50 undergraduate students.
Organize meetings, activities, and media to cultivate a lively, safe community for students to succeed at UC San Diego.
Collaborate and assist with UCSD administration regarding student safety, well-being, activities, and campus life.

positions.title: COSMOS UCSD Cluster Assistant
positions.description:
Provided technical expertise to 23 high school students C# and video game development on Unity Hub. 
Collaborated with Professors on developing and refining weekly lab content for students.

positions.title: Industry Outreach Director
positions.description:
Goal: Create community between rising Filipinos in tech, Filipinos in the tech industry, and Filipino-owned businesses and organizations.

Recruited 6 Filipino industry software engineers for workshop and mentorship sessions throughout hackathon
Recruited 10 industry software engineers and managers to participate in hackathon judging and on-call mentorship 
Developed 4 business proposals with stakeholders to present to hackathon participants for project development
positions.insights: Skills: Event Planning · Leadership · Program Management · Volunteer Recruiting · Proposal Writing

positions.title: Lead Website Developer
positions.locationName: La Jolla Shores, California, United States
positions.description:
Develop website for Kaibigang Pilipin@ with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs, and other front end development tools.
Managed 7 developers by steering their learning of development tools and guiding them through Agile development workflow.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · JavaScript · GitHub · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: BASTA x Google G-SWEP Participant
positions.description: Selected from a highly competitive applicant pool to engage in 10 weeks of pair programming and mentorship with a Google Software Engineer to strengthen foundational coding skills, enhance problem-solving abilities, and prepare for technical interviews.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.locationName: La Jolla Shores, California, United States
positions.description:
Tutored students in 1:1 sessions about data structures and object-oriented design.
Reinforced students' coding and debugging skills for weekly coding projects. 
Collaborated closely with other tutors and professor to refine assignments and exams.

company.name: UC San Diego Computer Science and Engineering Department (CSE)

positions.title: Enterprise Solutions Development Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed an Agile sprint dashboard and KPIs using Microsoft PowerBi, PowerApps, Jira Rest API, and Postman, streamlining processes to save 40+ hours annually
Led retrospective meetings as scrum master to review Agile sprint progress.
Developed AI-powered applications for financial processes
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · LangChain · Microsoft Power Apps · Microsoft Power BI · REST APIs · OpenAI API · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: UCSD Computer Science Representative - Tech San Diego "Ready to Work" Program
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Provided computer science student perspective and input for continuous improvement of program structure and outcomes.
Engaged in workplace skills development through employer-led curriculum from CEOs, company presidents and other tech executives.
Participated in workshops, panels and networking activities for successful transition into the San Diego workforce.

positions.title: Filipino Googler Network Kapwa Mentorship Program
positions.description: Joined a cohort of 33 students (chosen from over 100 applicants) to participate in monthly workshops for professional development in the tech industry, as well as connect with Filipino Google employees through 1:1 mentorship.

positions.title: Summer Engineering Institute (SEI) Peer Facilitator
positions.locationName: La Jolla Shores, California, United States
positions.description:
Mentored 86 incoming freshmen participating in the Summer Engineering Institute, a 5 week on-campus program where students earn school credits while acclimating to UCSD campus. 

Collaborated closely with Jacob's School of Engineering IDEA Center Staff and Peer Facilitators in organizing, budgeting, and implementing 15+ social and academic activities.

Facilitated weekly group and 1:1 meetings for a small group of students. Encouraged the academic, intellectual, multicultural, and social development of all members of the program; and set a standard of communal and individual behavior among students.
positions.insights: Skills: Mentoring · Educational Leadership · Program Management · Event Planning

company.name: UC San Diego Jacobs School of Engineering

positions.title: Aide to Dental Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted Senior Dental Assistant and Doctor during operation by holding tools and keeping work station clear. Greeted patients and assisted them while developing a positive and safe environment.

Copied handwritten patient information and scheduling information into computer and e-health systems.

Operated dental machines including operating the autoclave, X-RAY machine, and teeth cleaning extensions.

Developed skills in taking blood pressure, blood oxygen, and temperature levels.

Maintained COVID-19 regulations by sanitizing and sterilizing equipment and taking patient COVID-19 information.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Medical Records · Blood Pressure · Direct Patient Care

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentored three high school students in exploring STEM majors and college and professional preparation. Organized one-on-one professional meetings and group socials for mentees online. Created Instagram content for program: https://www.instagram.com/edge.ucsd/?hl=en

volunteerExperiences.companyName: UC San Diego Jacobs School of Engineering
volunteerExperiences.description: I introduced UCSD class of 2026 undergraduate admits to the Jacobs School of Engineering at a day-long event as they considered their college decisions. I gave them a tour of the Engineering campus, shared personal experiences for their college commitment process, and provided resources for them to become familiar with campus and college life.

projects.title: VR Lifesaver: First Responder AR Simulation
projects.description: I developed a drone flight simulation using C#, Unity, Meta Quest 2 (VR) that would detect medical emergencies in a crowd setting in order for first response teams.

projects.title: Volumetric Renderer
projects.description: Developed a volumetric renderer using Embree renderer and C++.
